prompt: how to make a race game in blender
response: Creating a race game in Blender involves modeling, texturing, animating, and setting up a scene. You can use Blender's built-in game engine to add physics and make the game interactive. Start by modeling the cars and setting up a track. Use materials and textures to make the cars look realistic. Animate the cars and set up the game logic. You can also add sound effects and music to enhance the experience.
